_about: Sir Richard Claverhouse Jebb (1841-1905), Regius Professor of Greek at Cambridge. Classical scholarship (lane B pivot, 2026-10-10): The Attic Orators from Antiphon to Isaeus (2nd ed., 1893, 2 vols.), The Growth and Influence of Classical Greek Poetry (1893), Homer: an Introduction to the Iliad and the Odyssey (6th ed., 1898), Bentley (English Men of Letters; 1901 printing), Modern Greece (1880) and the posthumous Essays and Addresses (1907), raw IA OCR. His Sophocles translations are on the sophocles shelf; the Sophocles and Bacchylides commentary editions are Greek facing and wait on the Greek-facing ruling. No uids minted. Selections from the Attic Orators, second edition (Macmillan, 1888), the Greek companion to his Attic Orators, raw IA. Round dy (2026-10-23) added, raw IA OCR with title pages read: his Catena Classicorum Ajax (Rivingtons; IA 1869) and Electra (second edition, 1870); Primer of Greek Literature (New York: Appleton, 1884, a dated scan replacing the one held back for want of a title page); The Work of the Universities for the Nation (1893); Macaulay, a lecture (1900); Some Aspects of Modern University Education (1903); and Caroline Jebb's Life and Letters of Sir Richard Claverhouse Jebb (1907). Not taken: the abridged Oedipus Coloneus (only a 1955 reprint is scanned).
